'''Deon Aarlaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] in the employ of [[Clan Ryo]] as a member of the personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|guard]] of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Volnos Ryo]], the head of the Ryo Syndicate and brother of [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Hawk Ryo]]. Around [[25,793 BBY]], Aarlaa aided Clan Ryo in the kidnapping of [[Oma Dessain]], the youngest daughter of [[Dessain Mining]]'s leader [[Eomin Dessain]], on [[Zerist]]. Sent to find the kidnapped girl and prevent violence from breaking out between Dessain Mining and its workers, Hawk Ryo discovered and attacked the kidnappers' stronghold in the town of [[Kainnan]]. In the process the ranger used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pull]] Aarlaa toward him, impaling the guard on his [[Sword/Legends|sword]] before he could sound an alarm.<ref name="Eruption" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deon Aarlaa first appeared in the short story [[Eruption]], a prequel to [[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]] written by [[John Ostrander]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 141]].<ref name="Eruption" />
